# A provider token on an assignment line is reported once, by the token rule (credential-assignment skips it).
# ruleid: lemoncrow.secrets.cloud-or-vcs-token
api_key = "AKIAABCDEFGHIJKLMNOP"
# ruleid: lemoncrow.secrets.credential-assignment
db_password = "qZ8vK2mRx9TpL4wN"
# ruleid: lemoncrow.secrets.credential-assignment
API_KEY: 'a8f3b2c1d4e5f6a7b8c9'
# ok: lemoncrow.secrets.credential-assignment
db_password = os.environ["DB_PASSWORD"]
# ok: lemoncrow.secrets.credential-assignment
api_key = "your-api-key-here-please"
# ok: lemoncrow.secrets.credential-assignment
password = "short"
